avis.texte: I have wanted a product that is not drying, greasy and makes your skin feel clean and soft. This does it all. Skin looks hydrated and glowing.

avis.titre: Worked very well on my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin - i cannot use most moisturizers and cleansers for this reason. I tried this on a whim, and it is amazing. I use this every night for my double cleanse before acne treatments, and it has changed the game. It eliminates all my daily grime and oil without making my skin too dry and irritated. I would recommend this to people with sensitive skin who have problems with oily/acne prone skin - it has greatly helped me in both of these areas.
I have used Murad products before and I trust their quality. But I hated and I wanted to try something more appropriate to my aging skin. I think I found it in this product.
Murad is convenient because such a little bottle lasts a long time, but my skin has irritated to it somewhat.
This is a great product, I have been using it for over 10 years.

I got this on sale in October, have used it a few different times and everytime I add it to my facial routine I break out. I'm 37 with combo skin. I use Foreo and Peach & Lily cleansers daily. Maybe it will work for you, but this product wasn't for me.

avis.titre: Nice middle of the road cleanser
avis.texte: I switch off with Tula and Murad. This line of Murad is now my favorite. I don't feel tight or greasy after cleansing. Just need a good pre-cleanse for heavy makeup days—especially for wsterproof mascara. Otherwise cleanses well on normal days.
Great for cleaning and refreshing your skin love it so much I use it everyday

avis.titre: I am beginning to Bible by this!!!!
avis.texte: Easy to use and great for sensitive skin!!!! Works well w combinationnskin

Use this face was in the morning and at night, it leaves your face looking so smooth and soft and clean!! I've been using MURAD Resurgence Renewing Cleansing cream since March 2020, and this one bottle lasted me a whole year. I just purchased my 2nd one. Just a little goes a long way! Buy it you will see the different in the first use! Worth every penny!

avis.titre: Can't wait to return this product
avis.texte: I've used Murad for years. Recently Murad discontinued my facial cleanser so I decided to try this product. Horrible. Product claims to be ultra moisturizing formulated to renew dull, dry skin. Left my skin dry and ashy with lots of blackheads.
Great for sensitive, dry skin. Leaves my skin feeling clean & soft.

avis.titre: Nice cleanser, but did not work for my skin
avis.texte: I had been using the Tatcha exfoliating cleanser for a year (as well as the rice polisher). It was great, but I wanted to change things up. I tried this Murad cleanser for a week. It seemed fine for the first few days, but nothing special. At the end week I got a huge whitehead (which hadn't happened for years) and my face felt greasy.. Last night I washed my face with it and did not use any moisturizer. Woke up with a very oily face! I liked everything about it -texture (gel), scent, etc.-it just didn't work for my skin type. I also noticed blackheads on my chin which weren't there when I used the Tatcha cleanser. Going back to Tatcha.

Very moisturizing which is what I was looking for. Works great for me. I am in my 40's with some fine lines and my skin was getting dry in some areas. I don't wear a ton of makeup so this gets everything except my mascara so I just take that off first. This is a great product.

I never had acne or any other issues with my skin until about 22. For years I couldn't find anything that would work for my combination skin. This is the only cleanser that works for my sensitive, yet oily, and sometimes dry skin. It's not tough enough to break through thick oil. So I do use the exfoliating cleanser from Murads purple line every other day.
I tried this for the first time & was impressed by the results. It's a wonderful cleanser and a little goes a long way! Great buy!

avis.titre: I changed back because it worked
avis.texte: I switched to a product I could purchase in my hometown but after 2 years I looked wrinkled and older. I switched back and my skin looks hreaty

I got this in a kit and didn't really try it bc I thought it was just another basic cleanser but I ran out one day and this was all I had so I used it and...amazing! It leaves my skin smooth and very clean, not dry or tight but the best is that it cleared my skin up. I have occasional hormonal acne and after I started using this it's all but disappeared. I would recommend trying this as a part of an adult acne regimen if you feel like your acne products are doing an ok job but you're still struggling with occasional clogged pores, the lactic acid seems to have really helped the performance of my other acne and retinoid products. I massage it into my face, work into a lather then allow it to stay on for at least 2 minutes while I use my clarisonic and it works great! You don't have to use much and the tube lasts a while, it's a nice cleanser and good value.
This cleaner is amazing for sensitive, acne prone skin. Not harsh but provides a gentle exfoliation but cleans without stripping. I been using it for a little over a year and it's awesome.
I really like the Murad line. It tackles multiple issues with one product.
I wish this was a bit cheaper but it's the first cleanser that works so well without drying my skins too much. So no problem paying the price.
Love Murad products haven't used one that I wouldn't recommend.
I have used this product for years; it use to have a wonderful, light scent; now it is so strong in perfume, I would not want it on my skin. MURAD needs this feedback.

I have been using this product for several years. I have tried others that burn my eyes and leave my skin feeling dry. I always come back to this cleansing cream. It lasts a long time and the price is reasonable. It does remove all my makeup.

avis.titre: Murad Renewing Cleansing Cream... THE BEST!!!
avis.texte: This cleansing cream is THE BEST!! Removes ALL makeup, including eyeliner and mascara. I have tried other brands and they don't come close. It's also very gentle. LOVE IT!

I was looking for a great face wash; something effective but nothing that would strip my skin or irritate me. I absolutely love this face wash. It's exactly what I was looking for. It doesn't dry me out. It leaves my skin feeling fresh and, while it's gentle, it is still effective at removing makeup. It lathers beautifully so I don't have to use a lot.
I use this product every morning in the shower. When I first switched I never had a problem with breakouts like other products. Removes left over makeup and leave skin feeling clean.

avis.titre: Best cleaner and products I have ever used.
avis.texte: I love the products and use many Murad products because they are great. I twll my friends and they also love them once they try them. I'm convened they help me look youthful.

I first started using this some time ago. I have dry to combination skin and the murad cleansing cream really does a great job of cleaning, hydrating and replenishing my skins balance. I use to have dry rough patches but now I get compliments on my skin. I tried other product but always come back to murad. I love it.

I have consistently purchased this product for several years now. I only use at night. Creates a luxurious foam that thoroughly removes long wearing makeup including mascara. No need for eye makeup remover. Don't be afraid of the price. A little goes a long way. It is a large container. Using once a day, a tube will probably last at least 5 months for me.

avis.titre: I'm 67 and have used this for years. It works!
avis.texte: It may seem a bit costly but you just use a tiny bit. I wet my face and hands with water and apply a pea size to my palm, rub my hands together and wash my face with my hands. Cleans very well without leaving your face feeling dried out. One tube last about 6 months used morning and night.
Have used in past however ordered online, so glad to have available in store!!
I have only used it once, but my face feels great. Bought for dry, aging skin, but haven't used it enough.

Have used for a number of years. The best when it comes to removing long wearing makeup. Eye makeup included. Because it is on the more expensive side, I use only in the evening to remove makeup. In the morning, I will use Aveeno Calming foam cleanser. Only takes a little of the product for a thorough cleansing. Tried many others. But I am done shopping around.

I always thought Murad was very harsh and only for people with oily, non sensitive skin. I was recommended this and It is one of my holy grail products! Super gentle, and I have dry sensitive skin. I use this as a step 1, step 2 being the redness serum. So happy with the results in getting, literally in just a week my skin has cleared so much.. I have been getting compliments on my skin. That's never happened before. It is a bit more expensive but so worth it!!!!!!!

Normally I go for the cheap stuff but someone gave me a huge starter pack for Christmas one year. Needless to say, I haven't turned my back on this stuff and I've been using it for a few years now. I've had acne prone skin and redness all of my life. This stuff has helped me to go out without foundation or cover-up. It does take a few days to work, but if used along with its other steps it's totally worth it.
I buy this again and again. Have tried so many cleansing products and I always come back to this. I use with my clarisonic and works great! My skin looks fabulous!

avis.titre: Not for me type of product
avis.texte: I try this out and I didn't feel as it clean my face and left is oily.

I'm usually a budget buyer- but once I tried this I've never gone back. A little goes a long way. I transfer it into a tiny jar and keep it in the shower- that way you don't accidentally squeeze out too much. (Just need a dime size)
I like the way my skin feels after cleaning my face with Murad. It cleans and hydrates. I'm not crazy about the smell but the results overcome the light smell.

avis.titre: Doesn't feel like my fash got clean
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this product however i didn't feel my face was truly clean after using. Also i started breaking out more and in areas i never used to get acne. Now that i stopped using this product my acne has lessened and almost disappeared. If a product works well I do not care about the price.

i love this stuff! i was looking for a gentle cleanser to use in the morning when I didn't necessarily have all the grit & grime i do at the end of the day. you only need a dab as it foams up nicely and cleans great without stripping the moisture from your skin. will definitely purchase again

avis.titre: Best cleanser out there for 'mature' faces!
avis.texte: I have recommended this Murad cleanser to so many friends! All my sister in law's use it now and LOVE it!

I use this product every morning and some nights. I love it. I get compliments on my skin even when I'm not wearing makeup. It is gently but effective at removing dirt and oil. Never dries my skin out. I do not have problem skin though. It's for people who have occasional break outs due to hormone changes, etc.
Helping to clear my hormonal breakouts and improves skin texture without drying.
I have mild rosacea on areas on my face and this cleanser does a great job without irritating. Have used this for several years now with no plans to change.

I have oily t zone but dry areas like cheek eyes. This is a night cream but after having kids I couldn't find a moisturizer that would fix my dryness without greasy feel. This solved the dryness and I just avoid putting too much in t zone. Really like this product I use it day and night. Only complaint is too pricey but it works!
This cleanser is very nice! It's best used with the line of resurgence products. I saw great results in less than 1 week!!

I stop by a San Ysido, CA. location to buy a Murad toner and other items, when a check out the lady a the register give me a free sample to try, after that I have been using this cleansing cream, I love it and my face loves it. I moved to Arizona and I had stop at Surprise, AZ location also at Bell Rd Location and Northern & loop 101 and had no luck trying a new product from Murad, one time I ask to see if I can get a sample of a daily lotion and they told me they do not sample :( Customer service is definitely not the same in Arizona.

I really don't like to have a million steps for face cleaning in the morning and at night. So I wanted a cleanser that would be a gentle exfoliate for daily use and this product is great! It gets off all of my makeup and rids me of a oily face feel! And my black heads have gotten better so far!

Started using Murad products in my 50s, there is one for every combination skin type. Lightweight and really helps smooth out the fine lines. The moisturizer really helps during the dry winter month. The cleanser works well with the ultra sonic device.

avis.titre: I can justify the price for this great product.
avis.texte: I look forward to using it every night to remove my makeup. My skin feels like I went to a spa evertime I use it.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again and again
avis.texte: As my skin started to age I realized I needed to try a different "gentler" face soap. I first bought this in travel size, and really liked it. I then purchased the large one. I have been using this for over 2 years. I recently went on a trip, but the store was out of the travel size, so I bought another cleanser. My skin ended up burning, dry and red after a couple uses. When I got home and used this once my skin felt back to normal.
I love the feel on my face very smooth lots of moisture but none irritating . Makes my face feel like it soaked up cups of water( which were needed)

I ordered this product from television not really expecting much, but was surprised at the 1st use. It made my skin glow and it didn't feel greasy. It's expensive but you only have 2 use a small amount so it's worth it. I left my cleansing cream at a hotel and of course no one saw it. So I go Googled the product n found out Ulta carried it n was excited. I'm a woman of color n most products don't work for us but this one is a keeper.

I use the cleansing cream twice a day along with the resurgence serum. My skin is combination, dry in some areas and gets oily as the day progresses. The cleansing cream gently but very effectively cleanses and exfoliates. When you get to be a certain age (I'm 42) your hormones change as does your skin, this is the only product that seems to help!! I def recommend using the serum too!
Does not irritate my skin. Calms my rosacea and leaves my skin soft and dewy.
This is a wonderful product. I have Discoid Lupus and allergic to a lot of products but this one is awesome! No irritation and keeps my skin feeling moisturized and clean.Excellent for aging skin.

I have been using this product for a number of years. It's creamy and lathers very well. My skin always feels clean, not dried out after using. I do notice a definite change in my skin resiliency whenever I occasionally run out of this cleanser. It is expensive; however, you only need a small drop each time you cleanse. Consequently, the tube lasts quite some time. I am always receiving compliments on my complexion. Highly recommend!
Just a small dab and my whole face and neck are cleansed. My skin is smooth and feels soft.
I use the cleanser every morning and every night and follow with Murad moisturizer. My 57 year old skin has never looked better.
I Have Been Using ThIs Cleanser For Years! I Love It. I Believe It Has Done Miracles For My SKin. It Evened Out Pigmentation, Helped With Fine LinesAndI Believe Makes Skin Clearer.

I am normally a budget-buyer but I will not skimp when it comes to my facial skin. My sister and daughter both use Murad and I thought that I would give it a try and since then, I have not gone back...it is simply the best. This works well for my skin as it is mature, deep wrinkles in my forehead and drying. I wet my face, put just a small amount of cleanser on my finger (think the size of toothpaste on your toothbrush) and then spot apply it to my face and work it around BEFORE getting it too wet. I find that this spreads it out so much better than wetting it in my hands and then putting it on my face - I was losing parts of the product down the sink before it ever got on my face. Anyway, then I wet what's on my hands, rub into a lather and gently cleanse my face. It rinses beautifully and leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh and NOT dry. Does it work overnight? Of course not so if you're expecting miracles, it's not going to happen. I've been using this about 3 or 4 months now and can see a definite improvement in the texture of my skin. It seems so much smoother, better tone quality and the pores seem to be not nearly as noticeable. I am quite satisfied with this product; in fact, I love the entire Resurgence line for my needs.
Immediate improvement in tone and even color in skin. Seems to smooth the old lady stuff and give some brightness. I am now inclined to try other products in this line.

Although this is an expensive cleanser, I feel it's worth it. My sensitive skin feels clean and smooth after using it daily. Since switching to Murad products I have had less blemishes and irritations.
I use it in the morning and evening. A small amount lathers up quickly and removes any dirt and makeup on my face instantly. Leaves my face smooth and soft, not greasy or oily.
It's is the best face wash and I won't use anything different
Use twice a day does a good job of removing makeup. I do not like the smell but I seem to be getting use to it.

This is a very nice cleanser for aging skin. It may be one of the reasons why I have so few wrinkles. Be advised, it does not remove make up, I use towlettes for sensitive skin (like neutragena) for that. I use it morning and night and follow with the rest of the Resurgence skin care line.

avis.titre: Keeps my face from getting too dry
avis.texte: I use this twice a day, every day with the clairsonic. It works great.

I looked a long time to find a cleanser that wasn't too harsh or greasy that would get my eye makeup off. This one does a really good job of that and my skin feels clean and refreshed. I only notice it makes my skin feel dry if I don't get my moisturizer on right afterwards. I have tried several other facial cleansers, but this one so far is the best for me.

I use this product twice a day with my clairsonic mia, it works great. I am 27 but get cystic acne occasionally, this product has helped with that. I have combination skin, but after using product my skin gets a little dry in spots. Besides that, it I like it and will continue to use it. You use such a small amount at a time, so it will last for a good amount of time.

I am not someone who spends a lot of money on what I wear, what I look like etc. But this product is worth it. I use it with a Clarisonic brush and my skin has never felt better or looked better. I don't have to wear alot of makeup going out, my skin feels clean, and when combined with other Murad products it is protected and cared for. Again it is expensive but it's worth it... and the bottle last 3 months.

avis.titre: I have used this product for several yea
avis.texte: I use the cleanser twice a day, it leaves my face feeling clean and soft

I typically do not buy expensive products to use for cleansing or makeup but some things are just worth it and this is one of them. My sister and daughter both use Murad and talked me into trying it and I must say that I was skeptical about how good this product would work and the price was more than I was used to paying. I did buy the cleanser plus two other products (took the survey on the Murad website and bought the suggested products)and was almost out of cleanser so I needed to buy some; I gave a lot of thought to just buying a cheaper cleanser at the store instead of Murad but when I looked into the mirror and again saw how much better my skin looks now that I have been using the Murad products, I just couldn't go back to anything else. I can see the difference and I like what I'm seeing...plus, I'm worth it. Love all the products that I have and I'm happy using them.

I just switched to Murad a couple months ago and really like the way this cleanser makes my skin feel. It gives me the moisterize I was looking for, without compromizing the exfoliation. I like Murad's gentle approach to exfoliation as you will see with this product. It might seem pricey on the shelf, but you only need about a dime size to wash your face and neck, so it lasts quite a while. Try this with the Toner and your skin will look and feel healthier.

avis.titre: Love how it makes my skin feel
avis.texte: I do not generally spend a lot of money of facial products for skincare. But...having said that, my sister and daughter told me that Murad was what they were using so I decided to give it a try seeing how good that their complexions are. At 63, I felt there was little that could be done to make my face look much different. I am amazed; I use it twice a day and my face does not feel dry nor does it have a pull from taking away too much oil. It feels really clean, but soft and smooth, which is wonderful. I use Clarion to scrub my face when wearing makeup and this cleanser does an awesome job - with or without the Clarion. Does a great job with just my hands and rinses really clean. It does cost a lot up front but believe me when I say that very little is needed to get a good lather, like maybe even less than a 1 inch strip. I find that it does better (for me anyway) to slightly wet my face, then after putting a strip on my finger, devide that up into four parts on my face and start the lather without adding more water until I get it spread out well. A little water, then, makes a great lather so it doesn't take nearly as much as you might think; therefore, the product goes farther, stretching out your dollar more. I am very happy with this product and the investment is worth it. I would give it a couple of weeks to see good results, although I was pretty amazed after the fourth day and that's a lot from me!
I have tried so many cleansing products because of my sensitive skin and so far this is fabulous!

I love this product! I tried this product on the recommendation of an Ulta store clerk when I really needed something soothing for my skin yet keeping my adult acne under control. It really works for me when I use it day and night in conjunction with the moisturizer of the same line which Ulta has been out of for a while now. :(

avis.titre: Best Cleansing Cream I've Ever Purchased
avis.texte: I have combination skin, some areas are extremely dry but others prone to acne. This Cleanser gets rid of wrinkles!! in addition to being a fantastic cleanser for skin of all types. It's definitely worth the money. After using it once, I won't buy any other.

I love the Resurgence Cleansing Cream. Cream sounds like a thick greasy cream you wipe into your skin and wipe off. This is nothing like that! It foams up on your skin with water and cleans so nicely without leaving you oily or dry. I love this product!

avis.titre: Perfect cleanser; little goes a LONG way
avis.texte: Expensive cleanser, but will last you a LONG time--you only need the size of a pea to clean your entire face/neck. Non-drying. Completely removes makeup from my face. Smooths on and cleans, making your face feel like silk. I also prefer to use a mild loofah sponge for a deeper scrub and lather.
I have used this produce for over 5 years. I have tried other cleansers but keep going back to this one. It is an excellent product for my aging skin and a little goes a long way.

avis.titre: Great for Sensitive Skin and Rosacea
avis.texte: This brand was suggested to me by a dermatologist and I use it with my Clarisonic brush. It doesn't irritate my skin and it doesn't leave your face feeling tight and dried out. I've tried many other products but I like this one the best for my skin.
I wish it would remove all mascara. Other than that, it is a very good product. Skin doesn;t feel dry or tight using it.

avis.titre: Best all in one cleanser ever!
avis.texte: I have struggled with acne and have found that if I use this cleanser; my breakouts disappear! I won't use anything else. Plus it exfoliates and hydrates, to help with aging too. It is a little pricey but you use a pea size at most 2x a day. Another plus is that I can use this product year round, no more switching products for the seasons. It has also allowed me to cut down on product cost overall as I use this and the Resurgence serum; that is all! No more than 2-3 products for me total. Additionally, it travels well and is packed in a nice squeeze tube that is luggage friendly. At the end of the day, i get compliments on my complexion - only when I use Resurgence!
I have very sensitive skin and it does a wonderful job of calming my irritated skin and balancing out my skin tone. The results are almost immediate - I love this stuff!

avis.titre: Great for Anyone with Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: Lathers great. leaves skin clean but not dry or oily. helps with rosacia.
Use daily I love the way it makes my skin feel. Also adds some color to my cheeks. A little on the pricey side for what I normally purchase but well worth the money for results.
I use this with my clarisonic brush and it's gentle and thorough. My skin feels clean but not tight and it doesn't irritate my rosacea.

I love the Murad facial cleansers and have been using them for probably 15 years. I switched to this one about 5 years ago (at 40!), and love it! I really like the texture of this cleanser and that it leaves my skin feeling clean, but not dried-out or stripped. I was prone to redness, but after using this regularly, my skintone stays even and balanced.
I use product in the morning & at night before I go to bed. I like the way it makes my skin feel so clean.
